description: This file implements the VaryingPacking class, which manages the mapping of shader varyings to hardware registers, including packing algorithms and register allocation for graphics rendering pipelines.

classes.name: VaryingPacking
classes.description: Manages the packing of shader varyings into hardware registers, including algorithms for different packing modes and register management.

methods.name: packVarying
methods.description: Attempts to pack a given varying into available registers based on its size and packing mode.

methods.name: isFree
methods.description: Checks if a block of registers is free for packing a varying.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a varying into the register map at specified position.

methods.name: collectAndPackUserVaryings
methods.description: Collects and packs user-defined varyings from shader programs.

methods.name: packUserVaryings
methods.description: Packs a list of varyings into registers, ensuring contiguous placement.
